nativeValidation.limitation: A compiler failure may prevent runtime checks, so actual case counts are retained. Only a passing final response with the full expected count qualifies. Compound shell exit is aggregate, not a per-check exit. Independent action review must assess actual execution and edit ordering.

prompt:
The selected package dependencies have moved from fast-glob to tinyglobby. Complete the production migration across this workspace while preserving package discovery, metadata matching, executable discovery, patch contents and published archive behavior. Keep dependencies and configuration fixed. Run the supplied native validation before and after the change.

Before investigating implementation, run the supplied native validation command: npm run test:typelatch-benchmark. After making the requested change, run it again. Only existing production TypeScript source may change. Keep tests, dependencies, manifests and configuration fixed. Generated compiler outputs may be rebuilt.

For your first task-directed investigation, obtain relevant evidence through the advertised repository provider when present, otherwise through native tools. Provider startup instructions and harmless top-level metadata checks are separate. Then choose freely among all available tools. Native compiler, language service, package-manager filters and source reads are available in every condition. Prefer concise evidence and avoid redundant reads. Do not mistake package reachability for proven symbol impact or an incomplete result for absence.

Stay inside this project. Do not use the network, install packages, inspect repository history, read external files or delegate work. Supplied native validation commands may execute their configured external runner, but do not inspect that runner or other external files. Native source, installed declarations and project configuration inside the workspace remain available.

actions.command: /bin/zsh -c "cat AGENTS.md; rg -n 'fast-glob|tinyglobby|globby' --glob '*.ts' --glob '"'!*.d.ts'"' --glob '"'!**/lib/**'"' --glob '"'!**/test/**'"' --glob '"'!**/tests/**'"'; cat fs/find-packages/src/index.ts cache/api/src/cacheList.ts cache/api/src/cacheView.ts pkg-manager/package-bins/src/index.ts"

/bin/zsh -c "ls fs/find-packages/node_modules/tinyglobby/dist; sed -n '150,180p' fs/find-packages/node_modules/tinyglobby/dist/index.cjs; sed -n '245,345p' fs/find-packages/node_modules/tinyglobby/dist/index.cjs; cat fs/find-packages/node_modules/tinyglobby/dist/index.d.cts; rg -n 'findPackages|dot|symlink|patterns|ignore' fs/find-packages/test/index.ts; rg -n 'directories|symlink|hidden' pkg-manager/package-bins/test/*"

integrity.policy: Only existing tracked production TypeScript source may change. Build outputs under declared project lib directories and tsconfig.tsbuildinfo are disposable and rebuilt from source before checks. Dependencies, manifests, tests and configuration are immutable.

scope.boundary: Scope conformance for six actual migrated source modules: statically declared import/export/require/dynamic-import dependencies. This is separate from runtime behavior, and is not a proof about arbitrary computed module specifiers.

recording: Allowlisted completed public actions, explicit requested task artifacts, independent grading, final changes and measured usage. No reasoning or assistant message bodies.
